measures.what: In mm: outside diameter and PCB thickness; looking at LEDs with wire exit up, measure the X/Y offsets of both mounting-hole centers from disk center (or center spacing and midpoint), their hole diameters, and the maximum safe screw head/washer diameter around each hole on LED face.
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk diameter: 242 mm; led disk thickness: 1.56 mm

measures.what: In mm: board width X, length Y, thickness, four mounting-hole center offsets from the edges (or pitches if symmetric), hole diameter, deepest underside solder/pin projection, and maximum component height above the board. Identify which board end or side the USB-C port faces.
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard thickness: 1.6 mm

measures.what: With ESP32 installed, measure the USB-C mouth center relative to the perfboard top face and center (or nearest edges); which direction it points; plugged cable overmold width, thickness, and length; and anything beside the port that could obstruct a plug.
measures.reply: esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge; charger plug head: its molded head is 11.58 mm wide and 6.44 mm thick, with about 7.5 mm of bare metal in front of it, from the tip to the head mm

measures.what: Are screws already installed? Give center-to-center spacing and whether horizontal, head diameter and thickness, shank diameter, and available gap from wall to underside of head. If new screws/anchors, say so and identify the wall material/support.
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most; wall screws spacing: I can put them wherever you say

measures.what: With wire exit up, measure where the 4-pin connector and any rear protrusions sit in X/Y relative to disk center, their size and height off the back, connector plug width/thickness and how far it needs to project or bend behind the disk, and available free wire length.
measures.reply: led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: 242 mm; led disk thickness: 1.56 mm

measures.what: Please give USB-C mouth height above the perfboard top and its sideways position: looking down on the component side with the 70 mm side running up/down, does USB face out a 50 mm end or a 70 mm side? Measure mouth center from both nearest perfboard edges, and tell me if it overhangs or sits inward. Also tallest height above perfboard top and deepest solder/pin below underside.
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard grid: 18 x 24 holes at 2.54 mm; perfboard thickness: 1.6 mm; esp32 height: its tallest point is about 18 mm above the bottom of the perfboard, in its female headers; 11.05 mm from the perfboard's top to the underside of its board; esp32 position: in female headers on the perfboard's columns 8 and 18, rows 2 to 23; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge; esp32 usb port height: the bottom of its USB-C receptacle is 12.54 mm above the perfboard's top, and the receptacle is about 3.2 mm tall and 10.67 mm wide, its centre 3.99 mm off the ESP32's centreline

measures.what: What is the largest safe head/washer outside diameter at EACH mounting hole, centered on the hole, with no contact with nearby LEDs/components? On the back at those holes, how large a flat circular support pad can touch safely?
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk diameter: 242 mm

measures.what: On back, how far do connector/other protrusions stick out, and where are they? With connector plugged in, how much depth do it and the wire bend need behind the disk, and how long are wires between disk and perfboard?
measures.reply: led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk thickness: 1.56 mm; perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm

measures.what: Please measure actual shank diameter and head thickness; what is the wall material and do your chosen anchors have a rated load and required screw engagement for it?
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most

measures.what: Please measure directly on the assembled perfboard: how far INBOARD is the USB-C mouth from the perfboard edge the cable points toward (negative if overhanging)? Does the cable point toward one of the 50 mm edges? With that edge at the bottom and components facing you, how many mm from the LEFT edge of the perfboard is the port center?
measures.reply: esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge; charger plug head: its molded head is 11.58 mm wide and 6.44 mm thick, with about 7.5 mm of bare metal in front of it, from the tip to the head mm

measures.what: Can the disk and perfboard separate by at least 45 mm face to face on their existing wires? Measure free length of shortest wire if possible. Is the disk connector actually on the back, the edge or the LED side, and how far from the disk center?
measures.reply: led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm

measures.what: Measure height from perfboard top to the top of the capacitor and screw terminals, plus maximum underside solder/pin stickout. This determines the enclosure depth.
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard grid: 18 x 24 holes at 2.54 mm; perfboard thickness: 1.6 mm

measures.what: Please test a loose M3 socket-head screw (5.5 mm head diameter) at both holes. Can its head sit entirely on bare PCB, away from LEDs and exposed pads? Will a 9 mm diameter support around each hole on the rear touch only bare board?
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk diameter: 242 mm

limitations.wanted: Print the rear enclosure in matte white PLA as requested.
limitations.blocked_by: The listed printer stock is black high-speed PLA; matte white PLA was not confirmed on hand.
limitations.why: The color and finish are cosmetic. Use matte white PLA if you have it; the same geometry prints in the listed black PLA.
